findings.title: Task 1 breaks the DuelState shape test in tests/duel.test.ts, and the plan neither updates nor commits it
findings.claim: Task 1 adds `throttle` to DuelState and to createDuel's return (plan L302-313). tests/duel.test.ts pins the exact sorted key list of createDuel(...), and that list has no 'throttle'. The plan only touches tests/duel.test.ts in Task 2 (L77-87). Task 1 Step 8 lists every test it edits, the commit at L485 leaves duel.test.ts out, and Step 9 (L446) runs tests/duel.test.ts and expects PASS.
findings.evidence: tests/duel.test.ts:L40-42 `expect(Object.keys(createDuel(layout, 5)).sort()).toEqual(['baseTick', 'decidedTick', 'events', 'helmPlayer', 'interior', 'nav', 'points', 'present', 'repair', 'round', 'tactical', 'weapons'])`; plan L84 (Task 1 test updates: duelModules, duelCheckpoint, duelSnapshot only), L446 (Step 9 runs tests/duel.test.ts, Expected: PASS), L485 (git add list).
findings.why: A subagent running Task 1 verbatim hits a red Step 9 before the bless. It has been told only to edit the listed lines, so it either stalls or improvises an edit to a file outside its commit list.
findings.fix: Add to Task 1 Step 8: in tests/duel.test.ts L41, insert 'throttle' into the sorted list, between 'tactical' and 'weapons'. Add tests/duel.test.ts to Task 1's Files ('Test updates') and to the Step 13 `git add` line.

findings.title: Task 2 misses one seed-7 pin: duelSnapshot's base-tick case 5157 is SPLIT + 1
findings.claim: Step 11 re-measures seed 7's split tick and re-pins tests/duelSnapshot.test.ts L68 and L74. But the round-module case at L117 uses `[2, 5157, /base tick/]`, which is the old split tick 5156 plus 1. It throws only because 5157 > header.tick. If the new split S is 5157 or more, that snapshot validates, and the case fails. Step 12 says the only test edits allowed are Step 11's pins and that any other failure is a defect in the task's code, which sends the executor hunting for a bug that isn't there. Whether S moves is likely: in seed 7 the Helm bot stands to repair (repairsFinished [6, 14]), and its sit tick now flies the kept level.
findings.evidence: tests/duelSnapshot.test.ts:L68 `scriptedDuel(7, 5156)`, L117 `[2, 5157, /base tick/]`; src/renderer/src/sim/duel/snapshot.ts:L149 `base > h.tick` throws; plan L806-809 (re-pins list), L817 ('The only test edits allowed here are the pins from Step 11').
findings.why: The pin procedure is meant to be complete and mechanical (brief item 6). One missing pin makes Step 12 fail whenever S ≥ 5157, with instructions that forbid the right fix.
findings.fix: In Step 11, add: `tests/duelSnapshot.test.ts` L117: replace `5157` with `<S + 1>`. Better, derive it in the test, e.g. `[2, d.interior.tick + 1, /base tick/]`, so it never needs re-pinning again.

findings.title: A few edit anchors are off by a line and could produce a syntax error or a duplicated doc comment
findings.claim: (1) duelOracle.ts: the plan says to replace 'the `38:` entry line and the closing `};` (L105-106)'. In fact L105 is the H-2 doc comment, L106 the 38 entry and L107 the `};`. Replacing L105-106 by number leaves a second `};` and drops the H-2 comment. (2) scripted.ts: 'Replace the first two lines of helmAxes (L95-97)' with a block that brings its own doc comment, but the old doc comment is at L94, so it would survive as a duplicate. (3) telemetry.ts: the Files line cites L11 for the comment that Step 7 edits at L14.
findings.evidence: scripts/golden/duelOracle.ts:L105-107; plan L412-419. src/renderer/src/sim/duel/scripted.ts:L94-97; plan L717-725. src/renderer/src/sim/duel/telemetry.ts:L14; plan L496 vs L744.
findings.why: Fresh subagents follow the numbers literally.
findings.fix: Cite duelOracle L105-107 (the comment, the entry and `};`) and keep the H-2 comment in the replacement. Cite scripted L94-97 (the doc comment included). Change telemetry `:11` to `:14`.

findings.title: Online: the console shows the new level one pump late
findings.claim: pump() hands the base to the source (`source?.throttleBase(...)`) right after reading the state, before play() runs. A press that sets throttleSent in that pump is not handed to the source until the next pump, so frame() draws the old notch for up to one pump interval.
findings.evidence: plan L1255-1260 (throttleBase set after L201) vs L1249-1250 (throttleSent set later in play()); src/renderer/src/app/duel/onlineDuel.ts:L198-212 (the order within pump()).
findings.why: A cosmetic lag of about 16 ms. It is not a correctness issue.
findings.fix: Also call `source?.throttleBase(throttleSent ? throttleSent.level : null)` at the end of pump(), after play(), or only there.
